ls -la && (which wolf || echo "wolf CLI not found")
cat package.json && find src tests -type f | head -50
./bin/wolf brief 2>&1 | head -50; echo "---"; ./bin/wolf call 2>&1 | head -30
./bin/wolf add --type decision --title "Session language: Russian" --body "Source: first user message of this session is in Russian (bug report about pagination). Date: 2026-11-17. Applies to dialogue, memory records, executor reasoning; delivery artifacts stay English." 2>&1 | tail -3
git log --oneline -10 --stat | head -40
node --input-type=module -e "
import { paginate } from './src/paginate.js';
const twenty = Array.from({length: 20}, (_, i) => i);
console.log('20 items, pageSize=20 ->', JSON.stringify(paginate(twenty, 20)));
console.log('5 items,  pageSize=10 ->', JSON.stringify(paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 10)));
console.log('empty,     pageSize=10 ->', JSON.stringify(paginate([], 10)));
"
node --test 2>&1 | tail -20
node --test 2>&1 | tail -10
git diff --stat && git diff src/paginate.js
./bin/wolf add --type note --facet history --title "Debug log: paginate extra empty page" --body "Symptom (bug report 2026-11-17): 20 items, pageSize=20 -> 2nd page empty. Repro: node import of src/paginate.js confirmed 2 pages; also found broader: 5 items/ps=10 -> trailing empty page for ANY non-empty input. Rev: base 47cb9e2 (seed), no prior history. Hypothesis: '+ (items.length > 0 ? 1 : 0)' in pageCount unconditionally adds +1 page for non-empty input; empty-input case already handled by pages.length===0 fallback. Discriminating experiment: removed term + red-green TDD: 4 new regression tests in tests/suite.test.mjs failed on pre-fix code (3 old passed), then passed after fix (7/7). Root cause confirmed. Fix: src/paginate.js line removed, fallback kept. Evidence: node --test 7/7 pass. Review: assigned to wolf-reviewer ses_e16e68826ffeCLB3uDKEHo7GPX (criteria C1-C6)." --related "src/paginate.js" --related "tests/suite.test.mjs" 2>&1 | tail -2

./bin/wolf add --type lesson --title "Runtime verification goes to wolf-tester, not wolf-reviewer" --body "Scope: this host's subagent harness (observed 2026-11-17). The wolf-reviewer session had no command-execution capability (Code Mode catalog enumerated: no shell/node/git), so a review mandate with executable criteria returned BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE despite valid static analysis. wolf-tester sessions DO execute shell (node --test, git stash round-trip). Practice: split review into static review (wolf-reviewer, read-only) and runtime verification (wolf-tester, executable procedures with restore steps); do not re-dispatch an executable mandate to the same reviewer instance without changed grounds." 2>&1 | tail -2
